title: Mornay / Cheese Sauce
description: A smooth, creamy cheese sauce made the right way — starting with a proper roux, then béchamel, then cheese.

method.instruction: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk constantly for 1-2 minutes to cook out the raw flour taste. This is your roux — it should be smooth and pale golden, not browned.
Gradually pour in the warmed milk, whisking constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Continue whisking over medium heat until the sauce thickens and comes to a gentle simmer, about 5-7 minutes.
Once thickened to a coating consistency, reduce heat to low. Season with salt, white pepper, and nutmeg (if using).
Remove from heat and stir in the grated cheese. Mix until completely melted and smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Use immediately while hot, or cover with plastic wrap pressed directly onto the surface to prevent a skin forming.

notes.title: Smooth Sauce Secret
notes.content: Warm milk prevents lumps and helps the sauce come together smoothly. Cold milk works too, but takes longer and requires more whisking.

notes.title: Cheese Choice
notes.content: Strong cheddar gives classic flavour. Gruyère adds sophistication. Parmesan brings umami. Mix cheeses for complexity.

notes.title: Thickness Control
notes.content: For a thicker sauce, cook longer or add a bit more flour/cheese. For thinner, add more milk. The sauce will thicken slightly as it cools.
